node.statement: Fix an arbitrary def-maincb-witness-ledger datum W and arbitrary explicit Stage-2 raw-call closed EXT-CB datum in A_R covered by node 1, with base scale 0<=t<=W.e_s2 and total post-helper defect e:=delta+epsilon_{A_R}<=C_s2^0 t. By def-extcb-datum and the precise output of lem-maincb-stage2-extcb-datum, A_R is a finite-dimensional extended epsilon_{A_R}-C*-algebra and its P,Q,v:M_r->S_P satisfy every hypothesis of conj-extcb. Also W.e_s2<=e_2 implies 0<=e<=C_s2^0 t<=C_s2^0 e_2<=e_ext.
